scope: Installed Node internal-source read only. No test or comparator execution.

observations.fact: FileTest counts reporter pass/fail messages; failedSubtests becomes true only for a parsed top-level test:fail.
Test file is launched in a child process with NODE_TEST_CONTEXT=child-v8; child stdout parsed as v8-framed reporter transport.
Child stderr is converted to test:stderr messages; parent awaits child exit and stdout completion.

Nonzero child exit or signal with no child error creates ERR_TEST_FAILURE(test failed). Failure type is subtestsFailed only if failedSubtests was set, otherwise testCodeFailure. Error has exitCode/signal and deliberately stack undefined.
Each test event serializes its error through internal/error_serdes and v8 DefaultSerializer before emission.
Errors during test bootstrap or reporter scope are rethrown; ordinary test failure handling is distinct.
TAP prints child stdout/stderr as comments and test:fail details, but cannot reconstruct an original error absent from supplied events.

inference: F2 generic file-level error is consistent with child exit1 without a parsed per-test failure, but these static paths do not establish the reason for missing child evidence or historical causality.

hypotheses.text: Module-load/registration/bootstrap exception before useful serialized test events.
Reporter or v8 error serialization failure interrupts delivery of actual test events.
Child exits or uncaught asynchronous failure without complete reporter output.
Actual adapter double still traverses trusted executable/config path validation before serving Docker data; environment metadata may differ from earlier qualification.

diagnostic_review_requirements: Observe module-load boundaries and exceptions through bounded side channel; rethrow exact exceptions.
Observe uncaughtExceptionMonitor without installing a swallowing uncaughtException listener.
Any unhandledRejection observer must preserve original failure semantics rather than convert process failure to success.
Preserve stdout/stderr separately and capture complete error name/code/message/stack/cause chains with explicit bounds/truncation flags.
Capture events and phase/case identity without changing comparator, assertions, registration order or source fixtures.
Preflight E1-E10 must pass before the single actual comparator diagnostic; no second attempt or correction inside D1.
disposition: STATIC_HYPOTHESES_ONLY; no causal disposition or qualification
